b) / s\n\ndef plabel(n, ops):\n    s = [\"I\"] * n\n    for q, l in ops.items():\n        s[n - 1 - q] = l\n    return \"\".join(s)\n\ndef maxcut_path_H(n):\n    # MaxCut sobre camino: diagonal, pero con p capas el circuito es profundo\n    t = [(\"I\" * n, 0.5 * (n - 1))]\n    t += [(plabel(n, {i: \"Z\", i + 1: \"Z\"}), -0.5) for i in range(n - 1)]\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t)\n\ndef hard_pauli_H(n, seed):\n    # T5: XX/YY/ZZ + campos — no diagonal, varios grupos de medida\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    t = []\n    for L in \"XYZ\":\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: L, i + 1: L}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.55))))\n        for i in range(n):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: L}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.45))))\n    # triángulos extra (más términos, más grupos)\n    for i in range(0, n - 2, 2):\n        t.append((plabel(n, {i: \"X\", i + 2: \"X\"}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.3))))\n        t.append((plabel(n, {i: \"Z\", i + 1: \"Y\"}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.25))))\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t).simplify()\n\ndef qaoa_prep(n, p, gammas, betas, idle_fn=None):\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)\n    qc.h(range(n))\n    for layer in range(p):\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n            qc.rz(-2 * gammas[layer], i + 1)\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n        if idle_fn:\n            idle_fn(qc)\n        qc.rx(2 * betas[layer], range(n))\n        if idle_fn:\n            idle_fn(qc)\n    return qc\n\ndef hea_prep(n, layers, params, idle_fn=None):\n    # params: (layers, n, 3)  ry, rz, rx\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)\n    for L in range(layers):\n        for q in range(n):\n            qc.ry(float(params[L, q, 0]), q)\n            qc.rz(float(params[L, q, 1]), q)\n            qc.rx(float(params[L, q, 2]), q)\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n        # CX “hacia atrás” → más profundidad / más ruido\n        for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):\n            qc.cx(i + 1, i)\n        if idle_fn:\n            idle_fn(qc)\n    return qc\n\ndef h_ideal(prep, H):\n    return float(np.real(Statevector.from_instruction(prep).expectation_value(H)))\n\ndef spectrum_span(H):\n    ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh(H.to_matrix())\n    return float(ev[-1] - ev[0])\n\ndef z_groups(H):\n    terms = list(zip(H.paulis.to_labels(), np.real(H.coeffs)))\n    buckets = {\"X\": [], \"Y\": [], \"Z\": [], \"I\": []}\n    for lab, w in terms:\n        letters = set(lab) - {\"I\"}\n        if not letters:\n            buckets[\"I\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"Z\"}:\n            buckets[\"Z\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"X\"}:\n            buckets[\"X\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"Y\"}:\n            buckets[\"Y\"].append((lab, w))\n        else:\n            # mezcla → medir en Z con cambio de base parcial no exacto; meter en Z\n            buckets[\"Z\"].append((lab, w))\n    groups = []\n    for basis in (\"X\", \"Y\", \"Z\"):\n        items = buckets[basis] + (buckets[\"I\"] if basis == \"Z\" else [])\n        if not items and basis != \"Z\":\n            continue\n        if not items:\n            items = buckets[\"I\"] or [(\"I\" * N, 0.0)]\n        groups.append(dict(basis=basis, op=SparsePauliOp.from_list(items)))\n    return groups or [dict(basis=\"Z\", op=H)]\n\ndef group_stats(counts, op, n):\n    labels = op.paulis.to_labels()\n    coeffs = np.real(op.coeffs)\n    vals, cnt = [], []\n    for bs, c in counts.items():\n        s = bs.replace(\" \", \"\")[-n:].zfill(n)\n        e = 0.0\n        for lab, w in zip(labels, coeffs):\n            par = 0\n            for i, ch in enumerate(lab):\n                if ch != \"I\" and s[i] == \"1\":\n                    par ^= 1\n            e += w * (1 - 2 * par)\n        vals.append(e); cnt.append(c)\n    cnt = np.asarray(cnt, float)\n    shots = max(cnt.sum(), 1.0)\n    return np.asarray(vals), cnt / shots, int(shots)\n\ndef estimate_energy(gcounts, gops, n):\n    h, var = 0.0, 0.0\n    for counts, op in zip(gcounts, gops):\n        v, p, shots = group_stats(counts, op, n)\n        m = float(p @ v)\n        h += m\n        var += float(p @ (v ** 2) - m ** 2) / max(shots, 1)\n    return h, math.sqrt(max(var, 0.0))\n\n# --- T1: QAOA p capas ---\nH1 = maxcut_path_H(N)\nbest, GAMMAS, BETAS = None, None, None\nfor trial in range(24):\n    g = RNG.uniform(0.15, 1.1, size=QAOA_P)\n    b = RNG.uniform(0.08, 0.55, size=QAOA_P)\n    e = h_ideal(qaoa_prep(N, QAOA_P, g, b), H1)\n    if best is None or e > best:\n        best, GAMMAS, BETAS = e, g.copy(), b.copy()\nspan1 = spectrum_span(H1)\nhid1 = h_ideal(qaoa_prep(N, QAOA_P, GAMMAS, BETAS), H1)\n\n# --- T5: HEA profundo + Pauli duro ---\nT5_H, T5_P, t5_best = None, None, -1.0\nfor s in range(120):\n    H = hard_pauli_H(N, s)\n    span = spectrum_span(H)\n    if span < 1e-6:\n        continue\n    params = RNG.uniform(0, 2 * np.pi, size=(HEA_LAYERS, N, 3))\n    hid = h_ideal(hea_prep(N, HEA_LAYERS, params), H)\n    cond = abs(hid) / span\n    if cond > t5_best:\n        t5_best, T5_H, T5_P = cond, H, params.copy()\nspan5 = spectrum_span(T5_H)\nhid5 = h_ideal(hea_prep(N, HEA_LAYERS, T5_P), T5_H)\n\nHAM = {\n    \"T1_QAOA\": dict(H=H1, h_id=hid1, span=span1, groups=z_groups(H1), kind=\"qaoa\"),\n    \"T5_HEA\":  dict(H=T5_H, h_id=hid5, span=span5, groups=z_groups(T5_H), kind=\"hea\"),\n}\nprint(\"T1 QAOA p=%d  h_id=%.3f span=%.3f groups=%d\" % (QAOA_P, hid1, span1, len(HAM[\"T1_QAOA\"][\"groups\"])))\nprint(\"T5 HEA L=%d   h_id=%.3f span=%.3f groups=%d cond=%.3f\" % (\n    HEA_LAYERS, hid5, span5, len(HAM[\"T5_HEA\"][\"groups\"]), t5_best))\n# profundidad aproximada (2-qubit)\nprint(\"aprox 2q gates T1≈%d  T5≈%d\" % (\n    QAOA_P * (N - range(n_phys):\n        ro = float(cal.get(q, {}).get(\"ro\", 0.02))\n        xe = float(cal.get(q, {}).get(\"xerr\", 0.001))\n        fr[q] = min(1.0, 6.0 * ro + 60.0 * xe)\n    return fr\n\nclass SimDevice:\n    def __init__(self, M, tls_frac, stale_flip, time_drift, delta_good, delta_bad, seed=SEED):\n        self.M, self.rng = M, np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        self.bad = set(self.rng.choice(M, size=max(2, int(tls_frac * M)), replace=False).tolist())\n        self.stale_flip, self.time_drift = stale_flip, time_drift\n        self.delta_good, self.delta_bad = delta_good, delta_bad\n        self.cal = self._mk(True)\n        self.live = self._mk(False)\n\n    def _mk(self, stale):\n        cal = {}\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            bad = q in self.bad\n            ro = 0.012 + (self.delta_bad if bad else self.delta_good) * 0.06\n            xe = 0.0006 + (self.delta_bad if bad else self.delta_good) * 0.0025\n            if stale:\n                ro *= 1 + self.stale_flip * self.rng.random()\n                xe *= 1 + self.stale_flip * self.rng.random()\n            cal[q] = dict(ro=ro, xerr=xe)\n        return cal\n\n    def step(self):\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            # deriva más agresiva en qubits “malos”\n            scale = 1.15 if q in self.bad else 1.0\n            d = 1.0 + self.time_drift * scale * self.rng.normal(0, 1) * 0.12\n            self.live[q][\"ro\"] = min(0.25, max(1e-4, self.live[q][\"ro\"] * abs(d)))\n            self.live[q][\"xerr\"] = min(0.08, max(1e-5, self.live[q][\"xerr\"] * abs(d)))\n\n    def noise_model(self):\n        nm = NoiseModel()\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            ro = self.live[q][\"ro\"]\n            nm.add_readout_error(ReadoutError([[1 - ro, ro], [ro, 1 - ro]]), [q])\n            xe = min(0.5, 3 * self.live[q][\"xerr\"])\n            nm.add_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(xe, 1), [\"x\", \"sx\"], [q])\n        for a in range(self.M - 1):\n            # CX peor si involucra qubit malo\n            base = 0.018 if (a in self.bad or a + 1 in self.bad) else 0.012\n            e = depolarizing_error(base, 2)\n            nm.add_quantum_error(e, [\"cx\"], [a, a + 1])\n            nm.add_quantum_error(e, [\"cx\"], [a + 1, a])\n        return nm\n\nbackend = sim_backend = device = None\nfr_live = None\nn_phys = None\n\nif MODE == \"cpu\":\n    device = SimDevice(**SIM)\n    for _ in range(3):\n        device.step()  # envejecido inicial\n    fr_live = friction_from_cal(device.live, device.M)\n    n_phys = device.M\n    cm = CouplingMap([[i, i + 1] for i in range(n_phys - 1)] + [[i + 1, i] for i in range(n_phys - 1)])\n    sim_backend = AerSimulator(\n        noise_model=device.noise_model(), coupling_map=cm,\n        basis_gates=[\"rz\", \"sx\", \"x\", \"cx\", \"measure\", \"delay\", \"id\", \"barrier\"])\n    MOTOR[\"ojos\"] = {\"active\": True, \"detail\": \"SimDevice mean_fr=%.3f bad=%s M=%d\" % (\n        fr_live.mean(), sorted(device.bad)[:6], n_phys)}\nelse:\n    from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService\n    service = QiskitRuntimeService()\n    backend = service.backend(BACKEND_NAME)\n    n_phys = backend.num_qubits\n    props = backend.properties()\n    cal = {}\n    for q in range(n_phys):\n        try: ro = props.readout_error(q)\n        except Exception: ro = 0.02\n        try: xe = props.gate_error(\"x\", [q])\n        except Exception: xe = 0.001\n        cal[q] = dict(ro=float(ro), xerr=float(xe))\n    fr_live = friction_from_cal(cal, n_phys)\n    MOTOR[\"ojos\"] = {\"active\": True, \"detail\": \"%s mean_fr=%.3f\" % (BACKEND_NAME, fr_live.mean())}\n\nprint(MOTOR[\"ojos\"][\"detail\"])\n\n# acoplamiento\nif MODE == \"cpu\":\n    edges = [[i, i + 1] for i in range(n_phys - 1)]\nelse:\n    edges = list(backend.coupling_map.get_edges())\nadj = defaultdict(list)\nfor a, b in edges:\n    adj[int(a)].append(int(b)); adj[int(b)].append(int(a))\n\ndef path_layouts(n_logical, blacklist, max_paths=50):\n    bl = set(int(x) for x in blacklist)\n    found = []\n    def dfs(path):\n        if len(found) >= max_paths: return\n        if len(path) == n_logical:\n            found.append(list(path)); return\n        last = path[-1]\n        for nxt in sorted(adj[last], key=lambda q: fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0):\n            if nxt in path: continue\n            if nxt in bl: continue\n            dfs(path + [nxt])\n    for s in sorted(range(n_phys), key=lambda q: fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0):\n        if s in bl: continue\n        dfs([s])\n        if len(found) >= max_paths: break\n    return found or [list(range(n_logical))]\n\ndef score(layout):\n    return float(np.mean([fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else True, \"detail\": \"continuar mean_fr=%.3f\" % mean_fr}\n\n# Reflejos\nblacklist = [q for q in range(n_phys) if fr_live[q] >= DD_FRICTION_THR]\npaths = sorted(path_layouts(N, blacklist), \"base=%s eqg=%s score=%.3f bl=%d\" % (\n    LAYOUT_BASE, LAYOUT_EQG, score(LAYOUT_EQG), len(blacklist))}\nprint(\"[Juicio]\", MOTOR[\"juicio\"][\"detail\"])\nprint(\"[Reflejos]\", new.delay(half, qa[0], unit=unit)\n                new.x(qa[0]); new.delay(half, qa[0], unit=unit)\n                added += 2; continue\n        new.append(op, qa, ca)\n    return new, added\n\ndef _force_prefix(tc, qubits):\n    from qiskit import QuantumCircuit as QC\n    new = QC(tc.num_qubits, tc.num_clbits)\n    qi = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(tc.qubits)}\n    ci = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(tc.clbits)}\n    added = 0\n    for q in qubits:\n        q = int(q)\n        if 0 <= q < tc.num_qubits:\n            new.x(q); new.delay(max(IDLE_US / 2, 0.5), q, unit=\"us\")\n            new.x(q); new.delay(max(IDLE_US / 2, 0.5), q, unit=\"us\")\n            added += 2\n    for inst in tc.data:\n        new.append(inst.operation, [qi[q] for q in inst.qubits], [ci[c] for c in inst.clbits])\n    return new, added\n\ndef apply_dd(tc, tgt, qubits):\n    if not qubits:\n        return tc, 0\n    qs = [int(q) for q in qubits]\n    before = int(tc.count_ops().get(\"x\", 0))\n    target = getattr(tgt, \"target\", None)\n    if target is not None:\n        try:\n            pm = PassManager([\n                ALAPScheduleAnalysis(target=target),\n                PadDynamicalDecoupling(target=target, dd_sequence=[XGate(), XGate()],\n                    qubits=qs, pulse_alignment=getattr(target, \"pulse_alignment\", 1),\n                    skip_reset_qubits=False)])\n            tc2 = pm.run(tc)\n            a = int(tc2.count_ops().get(\"x\", 0)) - before\n            if a > 0: return tc2, a\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    try:\n        durs = _durs(tc.num_qubits)\n        pm = PassManager([\n            ALAPScheduleAnalysis(instruction_durations=durs),\n            PadDynamicalDecoupling(durations=durs, dd_sequence=[XGate(), XGate()],\n                qubits=qs, pulse_alignment=1, skip_reset_qubits=False)])\n        tc2 = pm.run(tc)\n        a = int(tc2.count_ops().get(\"x\", 0)) - before\n        if a > 0: return tc2, a\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    tc2, a = _manual_cpmg(tc, qs)\n    if a > 0: return tc2, a\n    return _force_prefix(tc, qs)\n\ndef basis_change(qc, basis):\n    if basis == \"X\":\n        for q in range(qc.num_qubits): qc.h(q)\n    elif basis == \"Y\":\n        for q in range(qc.num_qubits):\n            qc.sdg(q); qc.h(q)\n    qc.measure_all()\n    return qc\n\n_dd = defaultdict(int)\n_cache = {}\n\ndef build_prep(kind):\n    if kind == \"qaoa\":\n        return qaoa_prep(N, QAOA_P, GAMMAS, BETAS, idle_fn)\n    return hea_prep(N, HEA_LAYERS, T5_P, idle_fn)\n\ndef make_circuit(hname, arm, cycle, gidx):\n    d = HAM[hname]\n    layout = LAYOUT_BASE if arm == \"baseline\" else LAYOUT_EQG\n    qc = build_prep(d[\"kind\"]).copy()\n    basis_change(qc, d[\"groups\"][gidx][\"basis\"])\n    tgt = sim_backend if MODE == \"cpu\" else backend\n    tc = transpile(qc, tgt, initial_layout=list(layout),\n                   optimization_level=1, seed_transpiler=SEED + cycle * 17 + gidx)\n    if arm == \"eqg\":\n        # preflight: DD en todos; luego condicional + peores del layout\n        if cycle < PREFLIGHT_CYCLES:\n            qs = list(layout)\n        else:\n            qs = [q for q in layout if q < len(fr_live) and fr_live[q] >= DD_FRICTION_THR]\n            if not qs:\n                ranked = sorted(layout, key=lambda q: fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 0, reverse=True)\n                qs = ranked[: max(2, len(layout) // 3)]\n        tc, nadd = apply_dd(tc, tgt, qs)\n        _dd[arm] += nadd\n    return tc\n\ndef get_c(h, a, cyc, g):\n    k = (h, a, cyc, g)\n    if k not in _cache:\n        _cache[k] = make_circuit(h, a, cyc, g)\n    return _cache[k]\n\ndef est_cost(n_circ, shots, per=350e-6):\n    return n_circ * shots * per + 3.0 * max(1, n_circ // 40)\n\ndef execute(tcs, shots):\n    if MODE == \"cpu\":\n        # derivar ruido entre lotes → desgaste temporal\n        out = []\n        for i in range(0, len(tcs), 24):\n            if device is not None:\n                device.step()\n                # actualizar noise model liviano cada lote\n            part = tcs[i:i + 24]\n            res = sim_backend.run(part, shots=shots).result()\n            out += [res.get_counts(j) for j in range(len(part))]\n            gc.collect()\n        return out\n    from qiskit_ibm_runtime import SamplerV2\n    sampler = SamplerV2(mode=backend)\n    job = sampler.run([(tc, None, shots) for tc in tcs])\n    jid = job.job_id(); print(\"Job\", jid, flush=True)\n    t0 = time.time(); last = t0\n    while True:\n        st = job.status()\n        nm = st if isinstance(st, str) else getattr(st, \"name\", str(st))\n        if nm in (\"DONE\", \"CANCELLED\", \"ERROR\"): break\n        if time.time() - t0 > 1800:\n            try: job.cancel()\n            except Exception: pass\n            raise TimeoutError(jid)\n        if time.time() - last >= 30:\n            print(\"  status=%s waited=%.0fs\" % (nm, time.time() - t0), flush=True)\n            last = time.time()\n        time.sleep(2)\n    if nm != \"DONE\":\n        raise RuntimeError(\"job %s %s\" % (jid, nm))\n    res = job.result()\n    counts = []\n    for i in range(len(tcs)):\n        data = res[i].data\n        c = None\n        for key in (\"meas\", \"c\"):\n            if hasattr(data, key):\n                try: c = getattr(data, key).get_counts(); break\n                except Exception: pass\n        if c is None:\n            for key in data:\n                try: c = data[key].get_counts(); break\n                except Exception: continue\n        counts.append(c or {})\n    return counts\n\nprint(\"builders OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T17:03:34.801206Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T17:03:34.801600Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T17:03:34.835114Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T17:03:34.801568Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T17:03:34.834325Z"},"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"builders OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":30},{"id":"e0925f3c-1572-4e7f-a73f-af5a1e4a5550","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 5.
